amenities.name: DSB parking
amenities.where: about 40 spaces at Jens Holms Vej; free but must be registered (DSB app / DSB Plus); 2 locked bicycle sheds

open: OSM has only platform 1 (ref 1); perron 2 (spor 2/3) is not in the extract, so which lift/stairs reach it is unsettled.
No lockers or ticket office listed by DSB.
Fratelli Kolding and Freddy's Cafe (OSM, next to the station, not tagged as in the station building) not included.
OSM does not flag the 7-Eleven and DSB toilet nodes as inside the station building (18 m / 45 m away); position words unconfirmed.
No published station plan (DSB, Banedanmark, Midttrafik/FynBus/NT) found on 2026-10-30; DSB publishes access only as present/absent lines. Level heights: no source measures them.
